headline.zh: 为AI智能体部署运行时安全防护
headline.en: Deploy runtime security for AI agents

scenario.zh: 企业部署客服智能体,需要在允许自主操作的同时防止越权访问客户数据
scenario.en: Company deploys customer service agents, needs autonomous operation while preventing unauthorized data access

instruction.zh: 确定需要监控的AI智能体应用场景
instruction.en: Define the AI agent use case to monitor

output.zh: 已配置客服场景:智能体可查询工单,读取客户资料,需限制修改权限
output.en: Support scenario configured: agent queries tickets, reads profiles, edit access restricted

label.zh: 数据分析智能体访问数据库

output.zh: 已配置分析场景:智能体可执行查询,生成报表,需阻止删除操作
output.en: Analytics scenario configured: agent runs queries, generates reports, delete blocked

instruction.zh: 定义智能体操作的权限边界和审批流程
instruction.en: Define permission boundaries and approval workflows for agent actions

label.zh: 严格模式:敏感操作需人工审批
label.en: Strict mode: sensitive actions need approval

output.zh: 策略已应用:智能体读取操作自动放行,修改客户数据时暂停并通知管理员
output.en: Policy applied: read operations auto-approved, data modifications paused for admin review

label.zh: 平衡模式:高风险操作自动阻断

output.zh: 策略已应用:智能体常规操作继续,批量删除和导出操作被自动拦截
output.en: Policy applied: routine operations continue, bulk delete and export automatically blocked

instruction.zh: 查看实时监控面板,检查智能体的操作记录
instruction.en: View real-time dashboard to inspect agent operation logs

output.zh: 发现3次越权尝试:智能体试图访问VIP客户完整信用卡信息,已全部拦截
output.en: Found 3 unauthorized attempts: agent tried accessing VIP full card details, all blocked

output.zh: 2个待审批请求:智能体请求更新客户等级和修改联系方式,等待人工确认
output.en: 2 pending approvals: agent requests tier update and contact change, awaiting confirmation

instruction.zh: 评估不同策略配置下的安全防护结果
instruction.en: Evaluate security protection results under different policy configurations

output.zh: 智能体自主操作无限制,潜在数据泄露风险高,缺乏可见性和追溯能力
output.en: Agent operates unrestricted, high data leak risk, no visibility or audit trail

output.zh: 所有敏感操作可控,越权行为实时拦截,完整审计日志支持合规要求
output.en: Sensitive actions controlled, unauthorized access blocked in real-time, full audit for compliance

takeaway.zh: Kontext在智能体执行操作前实时评估和控制,帮助企业安全使用AI自主能力
takeaway.en: Kontext evaluates and controls agent actions before execution, enabling safe AI autonomy
